verdict.rationale: Raygun documents Slack and PagerDuty integrations tied to alert rules (raygun-docs-16, raygun-docs-17), implying rule-based routing exists, but there's no evidence of email routing, or of granular per-rule thresholds specifically for new issue, frequency spike, and affected-user count, nor of routing by project/environment/severity combinations. missing for 10: email alert routing, explicit threshold configuration for new issue/frequency spike/affected-user count, filtering/routing by environment and severity, independent confirmation of rule granularity.
